items.q: Fill up: In the malignant-hypertension note, the new onset fundal changes are written as hemorrhage/______.
items.exp: The bracket reads: (New onset fundal changes: hemorrhage/exudate + emergency HTN: end organ damage + ≥180/120). (Book p753)

items.q: The heading 'Rheumatological Condition' is bracketed against catastrophic APS and diffuse scleroderma, and not against HUS or HELLP.
opts: True — only those two causes carry that label
False — HUS is also filed under rheumatological conditions
False — the label sits beside malignant hypertension

items.exp: The causes list runs HUS, HELLP, then the rheumatological bracket over catastrophic APS and diffuse scleroderma (Anti RNA P), then malignant hypertension; Takayasu and PAN appear on the opposite side of the vessel-size comparison. (Book p753)
